text_block_list.text:
Fool! Blockhead! Nincompoop! Oh, how

embarrassing...
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry, but I wish to be left alone for
now.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
I can't possibly look you in the eye after
what I've
done!
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text: I wonder why she took that so badly?
text_block_list.name: Student Council Member

text_block_list.text: All she did was flub a joke...
text_block_list.name: Student Council Member

text_block_list.text:
Argh! I was so proud of that one! I just
thought of
it last night too...
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф
